verdict: Clean: cleared with four stars and no fall, no console error, every spot reachable in both states of the paths; the rival (Sirix), the trial, the Antler King (own model) and the gate (Isolde) all played. The keeper's “feed him, and his door” is floor 13's fix.

found.text: The thicket's pack slept through the bot's route; the probe's hits are the Wood's trees, spore motes and the hills past the edge.
